Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Persian. Parents who choose Azarang usually hope their child will grow to embody golden and live with faith, good character and purpose.

This is a time of harvest and celebration, which is reflected in the naming traditions of Persian communities.

historical_references.reference: Azarang was the name of a Persian vizier during the Saljuq Empire in the late 11th and early 12th centuries. He is known for his role in the assassination of the Saljuq sultan Malik Shah I and for his subsequent rule as regent for Malik Shah's young son Mohammad.

Azarang was also the name of a Persian poet and scholar who lived during the Timurid Empire in the 14th century. He is known for his works on Persian literature and his contributions to the development of the Persian language.
